key_insight: HAVAPlot enables browser-only visualization and post-processing of simulation data without software installation or data uploads.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can inspect native OpenFOAM, VTK, and tabular datasets locally and export publication-ready graphics.
method: Read native OpenFOAM meshes, fields, boundaries, and particles alongside VTK and tabular data.
Apply exact polyhedral slicing, cell-to-point interpolation, variable calculations, and boundary extraction.
Visualize contours, streamlines, isosurfaces, and particles; export vector graphics and data.
evidence_signal: Independent checks reproduced 6.1 million field values to machine precision; interpolation showed second-order interior and first-order boundary convergence, and 250,000-cell meshes loaded in at most 1.3 seconds.
watch_item: Browser memory and performance on substantially larger meshes remain unestablished by the reported benchmark.
paper_title: HAVAPlot: A Web-Based Scientific Visualization and Post-Processing Platform
